findings.evidence: `DifferentialSquareCoefficient.lean:51` declares the theorem with no attribute, while the analogous existing coefficient API is simp-tagged at `Complex.lean:201` (`fullyBlockedDifferential_single`) and `Complex.lean:237` (`fullyBlockedDifferential_apply_apply`).
findings.fix: Add `@[simp]` to `fullyBlockedDifferential_sq_single_apply` unless it demonstrably loops; the rewrite strictly removes the differential applications.
findings.issue: `fullyBlockedDifferential_sq_single_apply` is the normal-form coefficient lemma for `∂ (∂ single)`, but it lacks `@[simp]`, so downstream coefficient goals will not simplify to the rectangle-count sum automatically.

summary: The coefficient formula is the main characteristic API added by this PR, but it is not registered for simplification, unlike the existing one-step coefficient lemmas it extends.
